They excel in roles that require adherence to established protocols and clear, repeatable processes. However, they can become noticeably uncomfortable when faced with highly abstract, unstructured problems or tasks that demand radical, untested leaps of faith. Their desire to maintain harmony often means they prioritize the comfort of the group over voicing a potentially unpopular truth. ### Internal World

Their greatest strength is their capacity for steady, unwavering support. Their primary vulnerability, however, is a subtle resistance to change. When faced with genuine uncertainty, they can become subtly anxious, finding deep comfort only in the predictable rhythm of a well-worn routine.
